name: io.github.staticvish/air-selangor-mcp
title: Air Selangor MCP Server
description: Query, monitor, and manage Air Selangor water utility accounts via remote browser automation.

environmentVariables.name: STEEL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your Steel.dev sandbox (e.g., https://steel.your-tailnet.ts.net)

environmentVariables.name: AIR_SELANGOR_ID
environmentVariables.description: Air Selangor NRIC, Passport, or SSM number

environmentVariables.name: DOWNLOADS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where downloaded e-Bill PDF statements are saved

environmentVariables.name: AUTO_LOGOUT
environmentVariables.description: Automatically log out and terminate browser session after query
